cohort: 174 women with term pregnancy undergoing Caesarean Section under general anesthesia.
finding: The incidence of unintended awareness during general anesthesia (AGA) during Caesarean Section was 6.9%, and body mass index had a significant relationship with AGA.
mod_finding: The study found an incidence of 6.9% for unintended awareness during general anesthesia specifically during Caesarean Section.
cross-section timing: Data was collected after delivery via face-to-face interview, with enrollment from May 2018 to August 2021.
